description: This PHP file defines a trait 'NormalizerTrait' used for normalizing model data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for handling model classes and data, and for converting models to arrays, including support for collections of models.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Returns the current model class name.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the data to be normalized.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data to be normalized.

methods.name: normalizeObject
methods.description: Normalizes a single object by converting it to an array after validating the model class.

methods.name: normalizeObjectsArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array or iterable of objects, converting each to an array.

methods.name: checkForValidModelClass
methods.description: Checks whether the model class implements the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: getInitializedModelInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the model, optionally passing constructor arguments if supported.
